MuseScore browser engine distribution notice

Package: @kreijstal/webmscore-wasm version 4.6.5-build.1
License: GPL-3.0-only. The complete primary program license is
LICENSES/webmscore-LICENSE.txt. Preserve this notice, LICENSES/ and build/.
This handoff copies the published core loader, WASM, data and SoundFont without
modification. The application owner supplies its browser Worker/API adapter.

included patches and rebuilds all WebAssembly objects from source.

Source availability when distributing the WebAssembly:
GPLv3 sections 4-6 require retained notices and license, and equivalent access
to Corresponding Source (including relevant build scripts and modifications).
When using source hosted on another server, keep clear directions next to the
binary and ensure the source remains available. The links above identify the
exact build inputs, not a promise of long-term third-party availability.
A modified or derivative combined program must comply with GPLv3 section 5;
separate and independent works in an aggregate are treated by its final
paragraph. A Worker boundary alone does not determine that classification.

Deployment:
Serve webmscore.lib.js as JavaScript, webmscore.lib.wasm as application/wasm,
webmscore.lib.data as application/octet-stream. The ESM loader takes
locateFile: path => new URL(path, vendorBase).href. No network score conversion
service is used. No SharedArrayBuffer/COOP/COEP requirement: this binary's
memory is not shared. It starts at 25 MiB and can grow to 2 GiB.
CSP needs script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; the unchanged core was compiled
with DYNAMIC_EXECUTION=0 and contains no eval/new Function. A file-based module
Worker can use worker-src 'self'; only the optional original Blob wrapper needs
worker-src blob:. Use connect-src 'self' for asset requests, and add blob: to
media-src and img-src when displaying generated audio/SVG through object URLs.

SHA256 and uncompressed byte length:
2ba26fdbec9522f5360bf5b1056c9e28b7ee57ff505013b478c8a5b29e8fb5ff  234507  webmscore.lib.js

68e82855c7e644e994c69754f66340baaf160630a5875c37500d6e8532b169d6  4195879  webmscore.lib.data

COPKU adapter modifications (29 October 2026): inline.mjs retains the published
high-level API and replaces the Node/research preamble with a same-origin
locateFile loader. It runs directly inside the terminable worker.mjs supplied
with this component. Runtime initialization also propagates loader rejection
instead of leaving its readiness promise pending after a failed asset load.
The modified adapter and all component modules are shipped
as readable source under GPL-3.0-only next to the WebAssembly.
